sloka: यदि वीर समग्रा ते मेदिनी निखिला वशे ।देवराज्यं कुरुष्वेह सभृत्यबलवाहनः ।। ७.६७.११ ॥
transliteration: yadi vīra samagrā te medinī nikhilā vaśe ।devarājyaṁ kuruṣveha sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ ।। 7.67.11 ॥

translations.english: O hero, if your entire earth is completely under your control, then you may establish the kingdom of the gods here with your servants, army, and vehicles.
